jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Initiatives - Career-Connected Learning
jobs.company: State of Maryland — Governor's Workforce Development Board
why: Exceptional overlap with Baltimore workforce-development program management and cross-sector partnerships.
Strong match for strategic initiatives, project management, data analysis, performance measurement and stakeholder engagement.
gaps: The role centers specifically on career-connected learning and CTE/apprenticeship systems.
jobs.summary: Senior operations and program management leader with 10+ years of experience directing workforce development, federal operations, healthcare initiatives, community partnerships, and data-driven performance improvement.
jobs.cover: I am strongly interested in the Manager, Strategic Initiatives - Career-Connected Learning position because it closely aligns with my experience managing workforce-development programs and cross-sector partnerships.

jobs.title: Senior Advisor for Strategic Communications & Public Engagement
jobs.company: State of Maryland — Developmental Disabilities Administration
why: Direct alignment with communications education, government relations, community engagement and executive-support experience.
gaps: Direct developmental-disabilities policy experience is not prominent.
jobs.summary: Strategic communications, public engagement, and operations leader with 10+ years of experience across healthcare, federal government, workforce development, community development, and government relations.
jobs.cover: This opportunity closely matches the intersection of communications, government relations, healthcare, community engagement, and executive support that has defined much of my career.

jobs.title: DDA External Affairs Director
jobs.company: State of Maryland — Developmental Disabilities Administration
why: Strong match for healthcare administration, government relations, public representation, strategic communications and executive leadership.
Your journalism/communications education and senior briefing experience align well.
gaps: Developmental-disabilities policy knowledge is preferred and not explicit on the resume.
jobs.summary: Senior healthcare, government relations, communications, and operations professional with 10+ years of leadership experience spanning population health, community development, workforce development, federal operations, and public engagement.
jobs.cover: The DDA External Affairs Director role strongly aligns with my background in healthcare, government relations, community development, strategic communications and executive support.

jobs.title: Director of Prevention and Health Promotion
jobs.company: State of Maryland — Queen Anne's County Department of Health
why: Population-health, community-health, grant-management and partnership experience align closely.
Strong fit for program administration, budget management and public-health leadership.
gaps: Centreville is a longer commute from Baltimore.
Behavioral-health administration is more prominent than in your current resume.
jobs.summary: Healthcare and public-health program leader with 10+ years of experience managing population-health, community-health, grant-funded outreach, workforce-development and community-development initiatives.
jobs.cover: My background in population health, community health and grant-funded program management aligns closely with the Director of Prevention and Health Promotion position.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Operations
jobs.source: Indeed / The Arc of Howard County
why: Good overlap with operational leadership, vendor/contract management, procurement, technology coordination and process improvement.
Past healthcare projects involving construction, IT, telecommunications, contractors and vendors are relevant.
gaps: Facilities/building systems and HVAC oversight are meaningful stretch areas.
jobs.summary: Senior operations and program-management leader with 10+ years of experience directing complex organizational operations, vendors and contractors, budgets, technology coordination, procurement support, projects, workforce initiatives and process improvement.
jobs.cover: I am interested in the Senior Manager, Operations role because it brings together operational leadership, vendor and contract management, technology coordination, budgets and cross-functional project execution.
